claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is set to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
Four astronauts will fly a 10-day mission around the Moon on Artemis II.
Artemis II will test the Orion spacecraft and its systems.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flyby of the Moon to test life support systems and navigation.
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II will use the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule will fly to the far side of the Moon on Artemis II.
The Orion capsule will travel further into space than any human has ever gone on Artemis II.
Artemis II will launch from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
China is planning the Chang'e-7 mission to the lunar south pole in 2026.
Chang'e-7 targets the lunar South Pole.
Chang'e-7 will survey the lunar surface.
The Artemis III mission intends to land humans on the lunar surface.
Artemis III is currently projected to follow after 2026.
